description: Five long prompts that trigger agent/thought/search phases. Probes DOM anchor consistency during and after generation.

prompts.purpose: Web search + long JSON stream: stresses hasActiveAgentStatusLines, incomplete JSON guards, reply scope during Thinking/Searching.
Long financial JSON with web search: thought blocks + multi-step agent status lines in .layout-chat tail.
Medium JSON schema: partial stream vs toolbar-ready mismatch on getLatestAssistantReplyScope.
Long prose research (no JSON): Thought section vs final answer; looksLikeThoughtBlock filtering.
JSON with preamble risk: scope capture may merge thought + answer incorrectly.
